body_markdown:
We’ve been busy building at Devyce from Call Time Filters for more precise reporting to a new Loxo integration to streamline CRM workflows, and Sensei Reporting for deeper call insights and faster coaching—all designed to improve visibility, automation, and performance.


### **Here’s what’s new**


#
**Call time filters**


‍


‍


Zero in on performance with new Call Time Filters. Managers can now run reports for specific hours of the day, making it easy to track consultant activity during sales sprints, peak calling periods, or focused campaigns. Get sharper insights, measure productivity more accurately, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.


[Find out more](https://devyce-knowledge-base.help.usepylon.com/articles/9832912493-live-call-stats-how-to-filter-and-export-them?lang=en) **‍**


‍


# **Loxo integration**


‍


‍


We're excited to add Loxo to our growing list of CRM integrations. Enjoy seamless contact syncing, AI-generated call summaries, transcripts, automated CRM activity logging, and Microsoft Teams integration - all designed to reduce admin and keep your team aligned. With customisable note templates and standardised data capture across every consultant, you can ensure consistent records, improved data quality, and a complete history of candidate and client communications, helping your team work more efficiently while maintaining a single source of truth.


[Contact Us](https://devyce-knowledge-base.help.usepylon.com/articles/9443806464-user-groups)


‍


# **Sensei reporting**


‍


‍


Sensei Call Reporting gives managers deeper visibility into performance with reports covering key metrics like average talk time, talk speed, question rate, and objection handling. Calls can be broken down by tags and activity types for more targeted analysis, helping teams spot trends instantly. Instead of replaying long recordings, Sensei takes you straight to the most important, coachable moments so you can review, report, and give feedback faster and more effectively.


[Find out more](https://devyce-knowledge-base.help.usepylon.com/articles/8226731445-call-coaching-reporting?lang=en)


‍


# **Coming soon for Enhanced customers**


‍


Get exclusive early access to trial our new data enrichment and integrity tools, designed to help keep your CRM data accurate and up to date. Keep an eye on your inbox over the next few weeks for details.
